inventory_revision_evidence.meaning: inventory_source_sha identifies the fresh verifier source tree whose first-party source paths and contents are accounted for; it does not identify this candidate artifact commit. The original additions scan used inventory_enumeration_source_sha.
inventory_revision_evidence.verification_base_changes: Between addition_enumeration_head and fresh_verifier_checkout_base, changed paths are limited to inventory candidate artifacts, ledger.jsonl, and work-order documents; all 1007 current-addition blobs are identical.

limitations: Baseline paths and line counts are derived from the accepted WO-RUST-PLAN-01 source-baseline.json and complete-inventory.json stored in legacy-c-final. All 603 canonical paths and SHA-256 hashes match tag blobs; all 603 per-file line records match newline and splitlines counts.

The accepted complete-inventory scope excludes generated, vendor/cache/build, worktrees/clones, and artifacts. Five tag-wide C/Objective-C paths under artifacts/ are listed individually with this exclusion reason.
No accepted per-file parity map could be substantiated for all paths; no accepted Rust replacement is claimed.
Historical tool scripts remain pending port; they are not treated as completed Rust replacements.
